_comment: Cases whose verdict or solver work measurably depends on the runner, per suite. A change of one of these, in outcome or in work, is reported and never alerts, in both the baseline and the previous-night comparison. Add a case only with the measurement that shows it changes on identical code; remove it once it is stable.

rr_ssa.MODEL2003200001|ssa: The screen tries its full t=0→100 ensemble under a 0.6 s per-replicate wall cap (ssa_screen.py REP_WALL_CAP), and this model's replicates take up to 0.50-0.55 s there, so one slow replicate decides the row: DIFF (partial_horizon, t=0→10) on every rr_ssa night from run 40899240805 (2026-10-29) to 42247324088 (2026-11-06), live and replay alike; the full horizon on 42493810983 (live: PASS, slowest replicate 0.497 s) and 42510555519 (replay: REFERENCE_FAILED, archive_unreplayable over t=0→100, 0.547 s); DIFF (partial_horizon) again on 42526819715 (#1600's own run). The code across those last three differs only in the ODE solver and sensitivity refusals (#1595-#1597), not the SSA path or the screen.
